description: The bar chart illustrates “Popularity” values for three content domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball) across three models (Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT), with each model shown using multiple patterned bars corresponding to legend entries “Acc=0 & GT Ans” and “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” alongside a solid-color bar. The horizontal axis contains the categories Movies, Songs, and Basketball in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Popularity” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 20, 60, 100, 140, 180, and 220. Within each category, bars are grouped by model and color (blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, yellow for ChatGPT), and each color appears as a small set of adjacent bars with different hatch patterns plus a solid bar; for Movies, the Llama3 (blue) bars are around the mid-20s to about 40, the Qwen2 (red) bars are around the high-20s to mid-40s, and the ChatGPT (yellow) bars are around the mid-20s to mid-30s; for Songs, the Llama3 (blue) bars are roughly around 50–70, the Qwen2 (red) bars around about 60–85, and the ChatGPT (yellow) bars around about 45–75; for Basketball, the Llama3 (blue) bars are approximately around 100, 155, and 180, the Qwen2 (red) bars are approximately around 100, 190, and just above 210, and the ChatGPT (yellow) bars are approximately around 100, 170, and 140. The bars are not presented as a single sorted sequence across categories; instead, they are arranged as grouped sets per category, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors and hatch patterns indicated by the legend.
